chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: حَكَى بَعْضُ الثِّقَاتِ بِنَيْسَابُورَ أَنَّهُ خَرَجَ لِإِسْحَاقَ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ مِنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ تَوْقِيعٌ: يَا إِسْحَاقَ بْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ سَتَرَنَا اللَّهُ وَآيَاكَ بِسَتْرِهِ …

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: One of the trustworthy narrators in Naysabur relayed that a Tawqi [signed rescript] came out addressed to Ishaq b. Ismail from Abi Muhammad (peace be upon him) saying: O Ishaq b. Ismail, may Allah protect both you and us with His protection …

chunks.arabic_text: فَلَا تَخْرُجَنَّ مِنَ الْبَلَدَةِ حَتَّى تَلْقَى الْعُمَرِيَّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ بِرَضَايَ عَنْهُ، وَتُسَلِّمَ عَلَيْهِ وَتَعْرِفَهُ وَيَعْرِفَكَ فَإِنَّهُ الطَّاهِرُ الْأَمِينُ الْعَفِيفُ الْقَرِيبُ مِنَّا وَإِلَيْنَا، فَكُلُّ مَا يُحْمَلُ إِلَيْنَا مِنْ شَيْءٍ مِنَ النَّوَاحِي فَإِلَيْهِ يَصِيرُ آخِرُ أَمْرِهِ، لِيُوَصِّلَ ذَلِكَ إِلَيْنَا …

translations.en: so do not leave town without meeting and conveying to al-Amri (may Allah be pleased with him) my satisfaction with him, greeting him, and getting mutually acquainted with him, for he is the pure, the dependable, the chaste, close from us and to us. Whatever is directed to us of anything from the different regions [of the dues] ultimately goes through him so that he can deliver it to us …

en.summary: This rescript (Tawqi) from Imam al-Hadi (peace be upon him) establishes Uthman ibn Sa'id al-Amri as the central financial agent (Na'ib) for collecting revenues (Khumus and Sadaqat) from various regions, emphasizing his purity and trustworthiness as a direct link to the Imam. The instruction for Ishaq ibn Ismail to remain in the city until meeting him highlights the formal recognition of his authority within the Shia administrative hierarchy during the Minor and Major Ghaibah periods.
en.seo_question: Who is al-Amri and what is his role in collecting revenues for the Imam?

key_terms.تَوْقِيعٌ: Signed rescript or letter from the Imam
key_terms.الْعُمَرِيَّ: Al-Amri (Uthman ibn Sa'id), a prominent deputy
key_terms.الطَّاهِرُ الْأَمِينُ: The pure and dependable (attributes of the deputy)
key_terms.النَّوَاحِي: Regions or districts (from which dues are collected)
